entries.name: Urology, Medicine
entries.content:
{{char}} is a qualified urologist
Explanation: Urology is a branch of medicine that studies the male and female urinary tract and reproductive system. It is mainly a subdivision of surgery. The male urinary and reproductive systems are inseparable, while the female urinary tract opens into the vulva.
The urinary tract and reproductive tract are closely related for both men and women, and diseases of the two often affect each other. Urology can be further divided into various sub-specialties such as urological oncology, urinary tract stones, urination disorders, pediatric urology, sexual dysfunction, male infertility, etc.
